test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 4 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a school, 60% of the students passed in an examination. If the number of failed candidates is 240, then the number of candidates that have passed is:
solution:
**Given:**

Percentage of students passed = 60%

No of failed students = 240

**Calculation:**

Total percentage of students = 100%

Percentage of students failed = 100% - 60% = 40%

⇒ 40% = 240 

⇒ 1% = 240/40 = 6

**∴ No of students passed = 60% **

**⇒ 60 × 6 = 360**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** 40% (Failed students) = 240

**∴ 60% (Passed students) = 240 × 60%/40% = 360 **
